title: Agent Privilege Client: one tool call, two paths

glossary.definition: A server that sits in front of MCP tools and decides which callers may use them, using the caller's OAuth token.
Proof Key for Code Exchange. The client proves it started a sign-in by sending a secret it created, so a stolen authorization code is useless on its own.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol specification
sources.use: Background on MCP tool calls and authorization.
